def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """Pack large models, improve by relocations, then use exact improving swaps."""
    placement = {i: [] for i in range(gpu_num)}
    free = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    load = [0.0] * gpu_num

    # Place large models first, choosing the GPU with the best KVPR after
    # accepting the model rather than the GPU's KVPR before the placement.
    for model in sorted(
        models, key=lambda m: (m.model_size, m.req_rate / m.slo), reverse=True
    ):
        size = model.model_size
        pressure = model.req_rate / model.slo
        ratios = [
            load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf")
            for i in range(gpu_num)
        ]
        best = min(
            (i for i in range(gpu_num) if size <= free[i]),
            key=lambda i: max(
                (load[i] + pressure) / (free[i] - size)
                if j == i and free[i] > size
                else float("inf")
                if j == i
                else ratios[j]
                for j in range(gpu_num)
            ),
            default=None,
        )
        if best is None:
            raise ValueError("Models do not fit in available GPU memory")
        placement[best].append(model)
        free[best] -= size
        load[best] += pressure

    # Evaluate every feasible relocation and make only the one that gives the
    # greatest exact reduction of the maximum GPU KVPR.
    for _ in range(len(models)):
        ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf") for i in range(gpu_num)]
        best_score = max(ratios)
        best_move = None

        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for model in placement[src]:
                size = model.model_size
                pressure = model.req_rate / model.slo
                for dst in range(gpu_num):
                    if src == dst or size > free[dst]:
                        continue
                    src_ratio = (load[src] - pressure) / (free[src] + size)
                    remaining = free[dst] - size
                    dst_ratio = (
                        (load[dst] + pressure) / remaining
                        if remaining else float("inf")
                    )
                    score = max(
                        src_ratio if i == src else dst_ratio if i == dst else ratios[i]
                        for i in range(gpu_num)
                    )
                    if score < best_score:
                        best_score = score
                        best_move = src, dst, model, size, pressure

        if best_move is None:
            break
        src, dst, model, size, pressure = best_move
        placement[src].remove(model)
        placement[dst].append(model)
        free[src] += size
        free[dst] -= size
        load[src] -= pressure
        load[dst] += pressure

    # A relocation-local optimum can still be improved when memory prevents
    # moving a high-pressure model directly.  Try a few exact improving swaps.
    for _ in range(2):
        ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf") for i in range(gpu_num)]
        best_score = max(ratios)
        best_swap = None

        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for dst in range(src + 1, gpu_num):
                for left in placement[src]:

                    lp = left.req_rate / left.slo
                    for right in placement[dst]:
                        rs = right.model_size
                        rp = right.req_rate / right.slo
                        src_free = free[src] + ls - rs
                        dst_free = free[dst] + rs - ls
                        if src_free <= 0 or dst_free <= 0:
                            continue

                            (load[src] - lp + rp) / src_free if i == src else
                            (load[dst] - rp + lp) / dst_free if i == dst else
                            ratios[i]
                            for i in range(gpu_num)
                        )
                        if score < best_score:

        placement[src].remove(left)
        placement[dst].remove(right)
        placement[src].append(right)
        placement[dst].append(left)
        free[src], free[dst] = src_free, dst_free
        load[src] += rp - lp
        load[dst] += lp - rp

        placement[src].remove(left)
        placement[dst].remove(right)
        placement[src].append(right)
        placement[dst].append(left)
        free[src], free[dst] = src_free, dst_free
        load[src] += rp - lp
        load[dst] += lp - rp
